why_best: Anchoring audio telemetry in a designated visual corner provides instant soundtrack context without stealing focus from the primary news broadcast.
why_bad: Centering the graphical element or making it dominate the frame disrupts the newsroom grid hierarchy and feels like an advertisement rather than ambient editorial metadata.
trap: A near-miss will render the progress element completely frozen instead of giving it the subtle live movement required for real-time broadcast fidelity.
